title: Fredholm--residue selection of the unsteady Kutta amplitude
summary: We give an operator-theoretic interpretation of unsteady Kutta selection in trailing-edge acoustic receptivity. The inviscid acoustic--wake problem leaves one outgoing wake amplitude undetermined.
